title: Lysine Deacetylase Substrate Selectivity: A Dynamic Ionic Interaction Specific to KDAC8.
authors: Toro, Tasha B; Swanier, Jordan S; Bezue, Jada A; Broussard, Christian G; Watt, Terry J
one_liner_zh: 该文通过MD模拟和活性实验研究KDAC8去乙酰化酶与肽底物的离子相互作用，对象为酶-肽而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或结构建模方法，与本课题TF-DNA结合机制研究无关。
abstract: Lysine acetylation and deacetylation are critical for regulation of many cellular proteins. Despite the importance of this cycle, it is unclear how lysine deacetylase (KDAC) family members discriminate between acetylated proteins to react with a discrete set of substrates. Potential short-range interactions between KDAC8 and a known biologically relevant peptide substrate were identified using molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. Activity assays with a panel of peptides derived from this substrate supported a putative ionic interaction between arginine at the -1 substrate position and KDAC8 D101. Additional assays and MD simulations confirmed this novel interaction, which promotes deacetylation of substrates. Verification that a negatively charged residue at the 101 position is necessary for the ionic interaction and observed reactivity with the substrates was performed using KDAC8 derivatives. Notably, this interaction is specific to KDAC8, as KDAC1 and KDAC6 do not form this interaction and each KDAC has a different specificity profile with the peptide substrates, even though all KDACs could potentially form ionic interactions. When reacted with a panel of putative human KDAC substrates, KDAC8 preferentially deacetylated substrates containing an arginine at the -1 position. KDAC8 D101-R(-1) is a specific enzyme-substrate interaction that begins to explain how KDACs discriminate between potential substrates and how different KDAC family members can react with different subsets of acetylated proteins in cells. This multi-pronged approach will be extended to identify other critical interactions for KDAC8 substrate binding and determine critical interactions for other KDACs.
abstract_zh: 赖氨酸乙酰化和去乙酰化对许多细胞蛋白的调控至关重要。尽管这一循环具有重要意义，但赖氨酸去乙酰化酶（KDAC）家族成员如何区分乙酰化蛋白，以与一组特定的底物发生反应，目前尚不清楚。通过分子动力学（MD）模拟，识别了KDAC8与一个已知生物学相关肽底物之间潜在的短程相互作用。使用源自该底物的一组肽进行的活性测定，支持了底物-1位精氨酸与KDAC8 D101之间可能的离子相互作用。进一步的测定和MD模拟证实了这一新型相互作用，该相互作用促进了底物的去乙酰化。通过使用KDAC8衍生物，验证了101位带负电残基对于离子相互作用及观察到的底物反应性是必需的。值得注意的是，这种相互作用对KDAC8具有特异性，因为KDAC1和KDAC6不形成这种相互作用，且尽管所有KDAC都可能形成离子相互作用，但每个KDAC对肽底物具有不同的特异性谱。当与一组推定的人类KDAC底物反应时，KDAC8优先去乙酰化在-1位含有精氨酸的底物。KDAC8 D101-R(-1)是一种特定的酶-底物相互作用，这开始解释了KDAC如何区分潜在底物，以及不同KDAC家族成员如何与细胞中不同亚群的乙酰化蛋白反应。这种多管齐下的方法将扩展用于识别KDAC8底物结合的其他关键相互作用，并确定其他KDAC的关键相互作用。
